data.name: HelpAndFeedback
data.comment: Help: eyebrow heading above the feedback and diagnostics links. Upper case, as every eyebrow.

data.name: StatusModeChooseTip
data.value: No game on this PC: choose the mode whose maps and data to browse
data.comment: Status bar: tooltip of the mode button, which is a menu only when there is no game on this PC to say the mode.

data.name: StatusModePve
data.comment: Status bar: the mode menu's item for the game's PvE mode (no game on this PC). The game's own name for it.

data.name: StatusModePvp
data.comment: Status bar: the mode menu's item for the game's PvP mode (no game on this PC). The game's own name for it.

data.name: StatusModeSeasonal
data.comment: Status bar: the mode menu's item for the game's seasonal mode (no game on this PC). The game's own name for it.

data.name: FeedbackButtonName
data.comment: Status bar: the screen reader's name of the feedback button (a speech bubble), which opens the Report dialog.

data.name: HelpButtonTip
data.comment: Status bar: tooltip of the help button ("?"). F1 is the key that opens help.

data.name: HelpButtonName
data.comment: Status bar: the screen reader's name of the help button ("?").

data.name: HelpTitle
data.comment: Help: the panel's title. Upper case.

data.name: HelpTakeTourTip
data.value: Seven short chapters over this window; Esc ends it
data.comment: Help: tooltip of the TAKE THE TOUR link. The tour has seven chapters; Esc is the key.

data.name: HelpTakeTour
data.comment: Help: link at the top that starts the tour. Upper case, small.

data.name: HelpWhatsNewTip
data.value: Shows what's new at the top of the list on the left again
data.comment: Help: tooltip of the link beside TAKE THE TOUR that shows the What's New card again, at the top of the left column.

data.name: HelpKeyBefore
data.comment: Help, first paragraph: the start of a sentence split for formatting: these words, then the screenshot key in bold ("PrtSc", filled in by the app), then HelpKeyAfter. Together: "In a raid, press PrtSc: the screenshot's name holds your position. …". Keep the space at the end.

data.name: HelpKeyAfter
data.value: : the screenshot's name holds your position. The map stays put; F shows you, Shift+F follows you.
data.comment: Help, first paragraph: the rest of the sentence after the screenshot key in bold (HelpKeyBefore is its start: "In a raid, press PrtSc"). F and Shift+F are keys. Keep the space at the end: the SHOW ME link (HelpShowMe) follows on the same line.

data.name: HelpShowMe
data.comment: Help: link at the end of several paragraphs that opens the tour at the chapter showing it. Upper case, small.

data.name: HelpFollows
data.value: Map, raid and quests follow the game's logs. No clicks needed while you play.
data.comment: Help: paragraph. Keep the space at the end: the SHOW ME link (HelpShowMe) follows on the same line.

data.name: HelpNextRaid
data.value: Between raids: where to go, what you can complete, what to bring. In a raid: the same card, each objective with its distance and direction.
data.comment: Help: paragraph about the left column, between raids and in a raid. Keep the space at the end: the SHOW ME link (HelpShowMe) follows on the same line.

data.name: HelpExit
data.value: EXIT: the nearest extract for your side, but only some are open each raid. Screenshot the game's extract list (raid start, or O twice): yours light up, the rest turn hollow, and OR is your nearest that needs nothing.
data.comment: Help: paragraph about the raid card's way out. EXIT and OR are the raid card's labels (RaidExitLabel, RaidOrLabel); "O twice" is the game's key. Keep the space at the end: the SHOW ME link (HelpShowMe) follows on the same line.

data.name: HelpQuestOrder
data.value: Quest order: go somewhere, then find or survive, then fight; simplest first.
data.comment: Help: paragraph: the order the quests are listed in.

data.name: HelpPointAtQuest
data.value: Point at a quest: its card opens and the quest lights up everywhere. Click to keep the card; a key, item or quest on it has a card of its own.
data.comment: Help: paragraph about quest cards. Keep the space at the end: the SHOW ME link (HelpShowMe) follows on the same line.

data.name: HelpPicks
data.value: Click a quest's pen to pick it for the coming raid, as many as you like. Picks come first, each in its own colour, with a line from you to the nearest, until done or unpicked.
data.comment: Help: paragraph about picking quests with the pen beside each.

data.name: HelpTicks
data.value: Done an objective? Tick its box on the quest's card (the logs can't tell): the map, NEXT and the plan skip it. HAND OVER on a line: take what it gets to the trader after the raid.
data.comment: Help: paragraph about ticking objectives done. NEXT is the raid card's label (RaidNextLabel); HAND OVER is the label of a line whose items go to a trader after the raid.

data.name: HelpReplay
data.value: After a raid with a few screenshots, the map replays where you took them, faint at the start, bright at the end. REPLAY on the last raid's line plays it again, until the next raid.
data.comment: Help: paragraph about the replay of the last raid. REPLAY is the link on the last raid's line (PlanReplay).

data.name: HelpQuestsFromLogs
data.value: Quests come from the game's logs only: one started before your oldest log isn't shown.
data.comment: Help: note under the paragraphs: which quests Shturmap knows of.

data.name: HelpStoryChapters
data.value: Story chapters (Falling Skies, Batya, …) aren't shown yet: tarkov.dev doesn't publish them.
data.comment: Help: note under the paragraphs. Falling Skies and Batya are names of the game's story chapters, as the game writes them.

data.name: HelpKeysHeading
data.value: KEYS · WHEN THIS WINDOW HAS FOCUS
data.comment: Help: heading over the list of keys. Upper case.

data.name: HelpQuestTypesHeading
data.comment: Help: heading over the quest types' symbols and what each means. Upper case.

data.name: HelpLegendHeading
data.comment: Help: heading over the map symbols' legend. Upper case. The app changes it to "ON THIS MAP" when help opens over a map.

data.name: HelpLegendElsewhereHeading
data.comment: Help: heading over the map symbols that aren't on the map on screen. Upper case.

data.name: HelpPrivacy
data.value: Reads screenshot names, the game's logs, tarkov.dev's public data and the extract list in a raid screenshot's top right corner (settings turn that off). Reads nothing from the game, sends it nothing. Nothing is sent unless you send a report or allow crash reports; an installed Shturmap asks GitHub for updates. Changes nothing outside its folders unless you tick Delete position screenshots.
data.comment: Help: note on what Shturmap reads, sends and changes. "Delete position screenshots" is the setting's name (SettingsDeleteScreenshots).

data.name: HelpCopyDiagnosticsTip
data.value: Copies version, what was found, data state and today's log (no names or ids), to paste anywhere
data.comment: Help: tooltip of the COPY DIAGNOSTICS link.

data.name: HelpCopyDiagnostics
data.comment: Help: link that copies the diagnostics to the clipboard. Upper case, small.

data.name: HelpReportingNotSetUp
data.value: Reporting isn't set up in this build: copy the diagnostics and send them to whoever gave you Shturmap.
data.comment: Help: note in a build that cannot send reports.

data.name: SettingsButtonTip
data.comment: Status bar: tooltip of the settings button (a gear). Ctrl+, is the key that opens settings.

data.name: SettingsButtonName
data.comment: Status bar: the screen reader's name of the settings button (a gear).

data.name: SettingsTitle
data.comment: Settings: the panel's title. Upper case.

data.name: SettingsPreferences
data.comment: Settings: heading over the preferences. Upper case.

data.name: SettingsDeleteScreenshots
data.comment: Settings: a tick box's words, and its name for screen readers: delete each position screenshot a few seconds after it was read. Help's note (HelpPrivacy) names it.

data.name: SettingsReadExits
data.value: Read the extract list from screenshots
data.comment: Settings: a tick box's words, and its name for screen readers: read the game's extract list from a screenshot that shows it.

data.name: SettingsCrashReports
data.comment: Settings: label of the crash reports choice, followed on the same line by its three choices.

data.name: SettingsCrashAskTip
data.value: The next start asks before sending
data.comment: Settings: tooltip of ASK AFTER A CRASH.

data.name: SettingsCrashAsk
data.comment: Settings, crash reports: a choice. Upper case, small; one line of 480 px holds the label and the three choices.

data.name: SettingsCrashAlwaysTip
data.value: The next start sends it without asking
data.comment: Settings: tooltip of ALWAYS SEND (crash reports).

data.name: SettingsCrashAlways
data.comment: Settings, crash reports: a choice. Upper case, small; one line of 480 px holds the label and the three choices.

data.name: SettingsCrashNeverTip
data.comment: Settings: tooltip of NEVER (crash reports).

data.name: SettingsCrashNever
data.comment: Settings, crash reports: a choice. Upper case, small; one line of 480 px holds the label and the three choices.

data.name: SettingsCrashNote
data.value: Holds the error, where it happened, versions and the last 50 log lines, user folder masked. No memory, screenshots, game files or ids.
data.comment: Settings: note under the crash reports choice: what a crash report holds.

data.name: SettingsUpdates
data.comment: Settings: label of the updates choice, followed on the same line by its three choices.

data.name: SettingsUpdatesAutomaticTip

data.comment: Settings: tooltip of AUTOMATIC (updates). "6 h": six hours.

data.name: SettingsUpdatesAutomatic
data.comment: Settings, updates: a choice. Upper case, small; one line of 480 px holds the label and the three choices.

data.name: SettingsUpdatesTellOnlyTip
data.value: Checks GitHub and tells you; downloads only on your click
data.comment: Settings: tooltip of TELL ME ONLY (updates).

data.name: SettingsUpdatesTellOnly
data.comment: Settings, updates: a choice. Upper case, small; one line of 480 px holds the label and the three choices.

data.name: SettingsUpdatesOffTip
data.comment: Settings: tooltip of OFF (updates).

data.name: SettingsUpdatesOff
data.comment: Settings, updates: a choice. Upper case, small; one line of 480 px holds the label and the three choices.

data.name: SettingsUpdatesNote
data.value: Downloads in the background, applies at the next start, never in a raid. GitHub sees your internet address, nothing more.
data.comment: Settings: note under the updates choice.

data.name: SettingsAppAndData
data.comment: Settings: heading over the game folder, Shturmap's folders and links. Upper case.

data.name: SettingsChooseGameFolderTip
data.comment: Settings: tooltip of CHOOSE… (the game folder).

data.name: SettingsChooseGameFolder
data.comment: Settings: link under the game folder's path that opens a folder picker. Upper case, small.

data.name: SettingsFindGameTip
data.value: Forget the chosen folder, find the game again
data.comment: Settings: tooltip of FIND AUTOMATICALLY.

data.name: SettingsFindGame
data.comment: Settings: link that forgets the chosen game folder and finds the game again; also the link after the note that another install has newer game logs. Upper case, small.

data.comment: Settings: tooltip of LOG FOLDER ↗. %LOCALAPPDATA%\Shturmap\logs is a folder's path: keep it as it is.

data.name: SettingsLogFolder
data.comment: Settings: link that opens Shturmap's log folder in Windows' Explorer. Upper case, small; the arrow says it leaves Shturmap.

data.name: SettingsPrivacyTip
data.value: What reports hold, who gets them, how long they're kept
data.comment: Settings: tooltip of PRIVACY ↗.

data.name: SettingsPrivacy

data.name: SettingsLicencesTip
data.value: Shturmap's licence and those of the code it uses
data.comment: Settings: tooltip of LICENCES ↗.

data.name: SettingsLicences
data.comment: Settings: link that opens the licences of Shturmap and of the code it uses. Upper case, small; the arrow says it leaves Shturmap.

data.name: SettingsUninstallTip
data.value: Removes Shturmap, as Windows' Settings → Apps does
data.comment: Settings: tooltip of UNINSTALL SHTURMAP…. "Settings → Apps" is the place in Windows' Settings app, as Windows names it.

data.name: SettingsUninstall
data.comment: Settings: link that asks whether to remove Shturmap (installed builds only). Upper case, small.

data.comment: Settings: the question after UNINSTALL SHTURMAP…, over a tick box and two links.

data.name: SettingsUninstallDeleteData
data.comment: Settings: a tick box's words under the uninstall question, and its name for screen readers.

data.name: SettingsUninstallConfirm

data.name: SettingsUninstallCancel
data.comment: Settings: link under the uninstall question that doesn't remove Shturmap. Upper case, small.

data.name: UpdateDownloadTip

data.name: UpdateRestart

data.name: WhatsNewClockMinutes
data.comment: What's New card: the unit beside the example raid clock's figure ("13 MIN"): minutes. Upper case, very small; figure and unit share 56 px.

data.name: WhatsNewPointAt
data.value: Point at one: the map shows it.
data.comment: What's New card: note at its foot. Pointing at one of its lines previews it on the map.

data.name: WhatsNewCloseTip

data.comment: Left column, between raids: tooltip of REPLAY on the last raid's line.

data.name: PlanReplay

data.name: PlanChooseGameFolderTip
data.value: Pick the folder Escape from Tarkov is installed in
data.comment: Left column, when no game was found: tooltip of CHOOSE GAME FOLDER….

data.name: PlanChooseGameFolder

data.name: PlanNextRaid
data.comment: Left column, between raids: heading over the maps ranked for the coming raid. Upper case.

data.name: PlanClearPicksTip
data.value: Unpicks this map's quests; other maps keep theirs

data.name: PlanClearPicks

data.name: CardSummaryTip
data.value: Complete: every raid objective doable here in one raid, no found-in-raid items, at most 3 kills. The rest only progress here.
data.comment: Plan's map card and the raid card: tooltip of the line that counts the quests to complete and to progress there. "Complete" and "progress" as the headings CardComplete and CardProgress say them.

data.name: CardPicked
data.comment: Plan's map card and the raid card: heading over the quests picked for the raid. Upper case.

data.name: CardComplete

data.name: CardProgress

data.name: RaidCheckYourKit

data.name: RaidAlsoUseful
